findings.description: Net PWM_DRIVE has 25% reference plane coverage over 51.3mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U2
findings.description: U2 (TPS61023DRLR) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U2 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U2 with short, wide traces to vias.

findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U1
findings.description: U1 (UCC27511DBVR) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U1 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U1 with short, wide traces to vias.

findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (Micro-Fit 3.0 B+/B-) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: J1 appears to be a power-only connector (all pins are power/ground rails). A board-level ferrite bead would saturate at typical power-supply currents. If radiated EMI is a concern on the cable, add a system-level common-mode choke or use shielded cable with chassis termination.

findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (Micro-Fit 3.0 M+/M-) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (55×21mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1299 MHz; (2,0) at 2599 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: MOTOR_MINUS
findings.description: Net MOTOR_MINUS has 4 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 4 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.

findings.summary: U2 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U2 (TPS61023DRLR) switching at 1.0 MHz has 59 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 30-88). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U2. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.summary: U2 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U2 (TPS61023DRLR) switching at 1.0 MHz has 129 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 88-216). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U2. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.summary: U2 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U2 (TPS61023DRLR) switching at 1.0 MHz has 745 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 216-960). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U2. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.summary: U2 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U2 (TPS61023DRLR) switching at 1.00 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.6 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 30th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
